decision.rationale: All 9 bundle datasets fit in 196 KB raw / 34 KB compressed. Plain JSON with optional gzip satisfies the ponytail principle: simplest neutral deterministic artifact. No SQLite, TopoJSON, or binary formats needed at current scale.
